name: $k$-Block Littlestone Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: For every fixed $k>2$, a depth-three k-block tree is level-constant on its first three levels and would shatter three coordinates, while VC dimension is two. The VC witness supplies depth two.
references: Directly from the block-tree definition and the $C_5$ calculations in \cite{palvolgyi2021unlabeled}.
